layout_and_grids.gallery_section: Filterable Masonry/Grid (All, Weddings, Pre-Wedding, Candid, Albums, Frames) with interactive Lightbox, EXIF-inspired metadata display (Shutter, Lens, Location: Kundapura/Balkur/Malpe), and high-resolution zoom.

layout_and_grids.interactive_booking_flow: Step-by-step Booking & Quote calculator (Event Type, Date Picker via Shadcn Calendar, Region in Coastal Karnataka, Package preference, Notes) with instant confirmation and DB save + WhatsApp direct payload.
layout_and_grids.studio_info_map_hours: Split section: Dark stylized map view with pinpoint (JQF2+W44 Balkur Proper, Hwy 576211), live status indicator (Open now · Closes 8:30 PM), direct call & directions button.
layout_and_grids.admin_dashboard: Clean Obsidian management portal at `/admin`: Login screen, Tabs for (1) Received Inquiries & Status management (New, Contacted, Booked, Archived), (2) Gallery Manager (Upload with title/category/caption, Toggle visibility, Delete), (3) Quick Studio Stats & Package editor.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis momentum smooth scrolling integrated seamlessly
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Staggered line mask animation using `motion.div` with initial `y: 40, opacity: 0` to `y: 0, opacity: 1` transition duration 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: Subtle 3D perspective tilt (`rotateX`, `rotateY`), 1px gold border glow on mousemove, and image scale `scale-105` with smooth 500ms easing
motion_and_interactions.cursor_element: Custom subtle trailing lens ring or refined hover state on gallery photos
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Haptic style button press (`scale-95`), floating badge pulse, Sonner toast confirmations for enquiry submits and admin actions

accessibility.contrast_check: All text adheres to APCA / WCAG AA standard (Minimum 4.5:1 on body text against #0B0C0E and #121316 surfaces; Minimum 3:1 on large 24px+ golden display headings).
accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: All motion transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by disabling spring loops and defaulting to instant opacity shifts.
accessibility.test_attributes: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and status badges MUST include semantic `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="hero-book-btn"`, `data-testid="booking-name-input"`, `data-testid="gallery-filter-weddings"`, `data-testid="admin-login-submit"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.html opening <html> with <html class='dark'> and use dark-first luxury obsidian palette with warm gold accents.

2. In frontend/src/index.css, import '@fontsource-variable/playfair-display', '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans', and '@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono'. Set --font-heading: 'Playfair Display Variable', serif; and --font-sans: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; --font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;.

3. Seed rich realistic studio data in backend/seed.py: include all 7 studio services, 12+ pre-seeded gallery items using the Unsplash photos provided with categories, real customer reviews (Anusha Kulal, Manjunath M, etc.), packages, and initial sample enquiries.

4. Ensure backend endpoints support: GET/POST `/api/inquiries`, PATCH `/api/inquiries/{id}/status`, GET/POST/DELETE `/api/gallery`, POST `/api/auth/login`, GET `/api/auth/me`, and POST `/api/auth/logout`.

5. Ensure the frontend has routes `/` (Studio Portfolio & Booking) and `/admin` (Admin Management Portal). Provide admin demo credentials in `memory/test_credentials.md` (e.g. admin@cropcreation.in / studio2026).
6. Build an interactive Lightbox for the gallery that opens on click with full-res zoom and EXIF detail overlay.
7. Include direct WhatsApp booking action (`https://wa.me/919591428115?text=...`) and direct Call button.
8. Ensure all forms and interactive controls use Shadcn Base-Nova components with dark custom styling, and test all flows end to end.
